boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Muhlenberg College
boards.description: Ten currently documented food destinations in Allentown with service extending to at least 11 p.m.; check the linked venue page before leaving, since hours can change.

cards.title: El Tablazo
cards.subtitle: 147 N 7th St, Allentown
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s order link or call ahead for a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday late meal; its posted schedule lists service until 2 a.m. on those days.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Dominican restaurant with documented 2 a.m. weekend and Sunday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: El Tablazo lists 147 N 7th St in Allentown and business hours until 2:00 a.m. Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: until 2:00 a.m. Friday, Saturday, and Sunday; Monday–Thursday close earlier. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: 849 Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 343 Hamilton St, Allentown
cards.notes: Plan this downtown stop for Thursday through Sunday evenings, then verify the day’s schedule on the restaurant site before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Hamilton Street restaurant whose posted schedule reaches 1 a.m. on four nights.
cards.evidence_claim: 849 Restaurant lists its Allentown address as 343 Hamilton St and posts 1:00 a.m. closing on Thursday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted late hours: 1:00 a.m. Thursday–Sunday; Monday–Wednesday close at 10:00 p.m. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Denny's on Catasauqua Road
cards.subtitle: 1871 Catasauqua Rd, Allentown
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check the current day’s hours before a late food run; the page posts service through 11:58 p.m. on several days.
cards.short_summary: A Denny’s location with official late-evening hours listed by day.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists its 1871 Catasauqua Rd Allentown location with hours through 11:58 p.m. Thursday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists service through 11:58 p.m. Thursday–Sunday; Monday–Wednesday schedules differ. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Anthony's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 502 W Gordon St, Allentown
cards.notes: Choose this Gordon Street pizzeria when a late takeout or delivery option fits the plan; its site posts 1 a.m. weeknight and 2 a.m. weekend closing.
cards.short_summary: A locally listed pizza destination with official 1–2 a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Anthony's Pizza lists 502 W Gordon St in Allentown and hours until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on South Fourth Street
cards.subtitle: 1761 S 4th St, Allentown
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to select carryout or delivery and confirm the operating mode; it posts late hours for all three options.
cards.short_summary: A South Fourth Street Pizza Hut with posted service extending past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists 1761 S 4th St in Allentown and posts restaurant hours until 2:00 a.m. daily, with dine-in until 1:30 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page posts delivery and carryout until 2:00 a.m. daily and dine-in until 1:30 a.m.; confirm mode before travel.

cards.title: Domino's on East Susquehanna Street
cards.subtitle: 2 East Susquehanna St, Allentown
cards.notes: Check the location page, then place a pickup or delivery order for this South Allentown store; the official listing currently shows a 1 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A Domino’s Allentown location with an official 1 a.m. closing listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's lists its store at 2 East Susquehanna Street in Allentown as open until 1:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 2 East Susquehanna Street
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently states “Open Today Until 1:00 AM.” Check the live page for the applicable day.

cards.title: Wendy's on Broadway Street
cards.subtitle: 4688 Broadway St, Allentown
cards.notes: Use the restaurant or drive-thru when the posted midnight closing works for your timing, and check the official page again before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A Broadway Street Wendy’s with midnight restaurant and drive-thru hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists its 4688 Broadway Street Allentown location as open until 12:00 a.m. daily for both restaurant and drive-thru service.
cards.access_notes: Official page posts restaurant and drive-thru hours of 10:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. daily. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Wendy's on Cedar Crest Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 450 S Cedar Crest Blvd, Allentown
cards.notes: For a later drive-thru or restaurant pickup, consult the location page before departure; it currently lists the same 1 a.m. close every day.
cards.short_summary: A Cedar Crest Boulevard Wendy’s with official daily 1 a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists its 450 S Cedar Crest Blvd Allentown location as open until 1:00 a.m. daily for restaurant and drive-thru service.
cards.access_notes: Official page posts restaurant and drive-thru hours of 10:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. daily. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Cooper Street
cards.subtitle: 301 Cooper St, Allentown
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru late and distinguish it from dine-in service: the official page posts later drive-thru hours, particularly on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Cooper Street Taco Bell with drive-thru service through 2 a.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists 301 Cooper St in Allentown with drive-thru hours until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is posted until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: The Dime Restaurant
cards.subtitle: Renaissance Allentown Hotel, 12 N 7th St
cards.notes: For a seated downtown meal, use the restaurant’s late-night menu window and verify availability before going; it lists food service from 9 to 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A hotel restaurant with a distinct nightly late-food service window.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dime Restaurant at the Renaissance Allentown Hotel lists late-night food service from 9:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Late Night from 9:00 p.m.–11:00 p.m. Check reservations and current service before travel.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Muhlenberg destinations for studying, gathering, performances, exhibitions, and hands-on learning.

cards.title: Trexler Library
cards.subtitle: Research, group work, and quiet study
cards.notes: Choose a floor to match the task: the library provides spaces ranging from collaborative areas to silent independent study, plus research help.
cards.short_summary: A three-floor library built for different study modes and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: Trexler Library offers noisy collaborative work, silent independent study, and workspaces from carrels to couches and bean bag chairs.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary; the College states that Muhlenberg ID is required to enter after 8 p.m.

cards.entity_name: J. Conrad and Hazel J. Seegers Union
cards.title: Seegers Union
cards.subtitle: Campus events, food, and meet-ups
cards.notes: Use the Event Space or Red Door Cafe for a campus program, then settle in where students eat, socialize, study, and connect.
cards.short_summary: A central student union combining events, dining, and study time.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg describes Seegers Union as a place where students eat, socialize, attend events, and study.
cards.access_notes: The information desk is listed as open daily from 9 a.m. to 11 p.m.; individual venues and events may differ.

cards.entity_name: Fahy Commons for Public Engagement and Innovation
cards.title: Fahy Commons
cards.subtitle: Programming space above Cedar Beach Park
cards.notes: Look for campus programming in its gathering areas, or use the building as a visible stop between the arts buildings and Parkway Boulevard.
cards.short_summary: A 2023 academic and student-programming building on the hillside.
cards.evidence_claim: Fahy Commons opened in January 2023 with more than 20,000 square feet of student programming and academic space.
cards.access_notes: Use of rooms and programmed areas depends on campus scheduling.

cards.title: Martin Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Baker Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Drop in during public gallery hours to view rotating exhibitions, then use the show details to find artist talks, receptions, or related programs.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery with a permanent collection and rotating public exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Martin Art Gallery presents free, public exhibitions and programming and employs student gallery assistants.
cards.access_notes: Listed public hours are Tuesday through Saturday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.; closed during College holidays.

cards.entity_name: Baker Center for the Arts Galleria
cards.title: Baker Center Galleria
cards.subtitle: Art displays in the Baker Center atrium
cards.notes: Walk through the atrium exhibition area between classes or before an arts event, and pause with the changing displays from the College collection.
cards.short_summary: An atrium-accessible exhibition area that can show multiple works at once.
cards.evidence_claim: The Martin Art Gallery identifies the Galleria as a primary exhibition area that holds multiple exhibitions and permanent-collection works simultaneously.
cards.access_notes: Exhibition spaces are accessible through the Baker Center atrium; displays change.

cards.title: Miller Forum
cards.subtitle: Moyer Hall speaker and event venue
cards.notes: Check the College calendar for a lecture or public event, then arrive with time to find seating in this large Moyer Hall gathering space.
cards.short_summary: A Moyer Hall forum used for guest lectures and other public events.
cards.evidence_claim: Moyer Hall's Miller Forum frequently accommodates guest lecturers and other public events.
cards.access_notes: Access is event-dependent; confirm the specific program's location and attendance details.

cards.title: Recital Hall
cards.subtitle: Baker Center for the Arts music venue
cards.notes: Watch the music calendar for student recitals, guest-artist sessions, and concerts held in this Baker Center performance room.
cards.short_summary: A named music-performance venue hosting student and visiting artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg's music schedule lists student recitals and music events in Recital Hall at the Baker Center for the Arts.
cards.access_notes: Performance access and start times depend on the published music-events schedule.

cards.title: Paul C. Empie Theatre
cards.subtitle: Baker Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Use the performance calendar to find a theatre, ensemble, or student-composer program, and plan around the event's separate ticket details.
cards.short_summary: A 392-seat campus theatre used by the Theatre and Dance department.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg identifies the Paul C. Empie Theatre as a 392-seat stadium-style theatre among its Theatre and Dance facilities.
cards.access_notes: Venue access is tied to scheduled performances and events; ticket requirements can vary.

cards.title: Studio Theatre
cards.subtitle: Trexler Pavilion for Theatre & Dance
cards.notes: Look for a smaller-scale production or concert in the Trexler Pavilion, where the flexible seating makes each program's layout part of the visit.
cards.short_summary: A flexible black-box performance space in Trexler Pavilion.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg describes the Studio Theatre as a black-box-style space with flexible seating for about 100.
cards.access_notes: Access is for scheduled productions, classes, and events; consult the relevant event listing.

cards.title: Acopian Center for Ornithology
cards.subtitle: Collection-based natural-science learning
cards.notes: Use this as a research-focused stop to learn how a campus bird collection supports specialized classes and collection-based investigation.
cards.short_summary: A campus ornithology center with a historic mounted-bird collection and research library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Acopian Center houses a 2,000-plus-piece mounted bird collection and research library used by students, faculty, and the Lehigh Valley community.
cards.access_notes: Contact the center for information about research and collection access.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten named Allentown walking destinations from the City’s free Million Clicks walking program.

cards.title: Walk LifeTrail together
cards.subtitle: Cedar Creek Parkway · Allentown
cards.notes: Meet at the trail across from the pavilions and enter from Honochick Drive. Walk the route at an easy group pace, then use the benches for a reset.
cards.short_summary: A named Cedar Creek Parkway trail stop for an unstructured outdoor catch-up.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists LifeTrail in Cedar Creek Parkway as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: trail across from pavilions; enter on Honochick Drive. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Take the Trexler Park loop
cards.subtitle: Trexler Park · Allentown
cards.notes: Start near the pond at the main trail entrance off Springhouse Road. Keep the plan simple: walk a loop, pause by the water, and head out before dusk.
cards.short_summary: A pond-side trail entrance for a no-cost group walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Trexler Park’s main trail entrance near the pond as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: main trail entrance near the pond; enter on Springhouse Road. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Stretch your legs at Andre Reed Park
cards.subtitle: Andre Reed Park · Allentown
cards.notes: Use the park sign near Irving Street as the meetup point, then take a conversational walk through the park. Bring water if needed; no ticket or purchase is part of this plan.
cards.short_summary: A named city park stop for an easy walk and conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Andre Reed Park as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: near the park sign; enter on Irving Street. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Walk the Hamilton Mile
cards.subtitle: Hamilton Street and 7th Street · Downtown Allentown
cards.notes: Gather by PPL Center at Hamilton and 7th Streets, then make the city block walk your hang. Keep it to public sidewalks and use crosswalks for the route.
cards.short_summary: A downtown walking checkpoint centered on a named arena landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists the Hamilton Mile at PPL Center, at Hamilton and 7th Streets, as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions identify PPL Center at Hamilton and 7th Streets. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.entity_name: Lehigh Parkway Robin Hood Bridge Trail
cards.title: Meet by Robin Hood Bridge
cards.subtitle: Lehigh Parkway · Allentown
cards.notes: Enter through 15th Street and use the trail near Robin Hood Bridge for a low-key walk. Stay on the marked route and schedule the outing while the park is open.
cards.short_summary: A named Lehigh Parkway trail point anchored by Robin Hood Bridge.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists the Lehigh Parkway trail near Robin Hood Bridge as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: trail near Robin Hood Bridge; enter through 15th Street. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Walk to the Covered Bridge
cards.subtitle: Lehigh Parkway · Allentown
cards.notes: Use the trail near the Covered Bridge as a clear meetup landmark. Make the outing a stroll and photo stop, while following posted park rules and leaving before dusk.
cards.short_summary: A bridge-centered Lehigh Parkway walk with an identifiable landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists the Lehigh Parkway trail near the Covered Bridge as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions identify the trail near the Covered Bridge. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Circle West Park’s bandshell
cards.subtitle: West Park · Allentown
cards.notes: Meet at the kiosk near the bandshell, then take a lap through the park and linger on a bench to talk. This is a daytime outdoor plan with no purchase built in.
cards.short_summary: A park walk that uses the bandshell kiosk as its rendezvous point.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists West Park’s kiosk near the bandshell as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: kiosk near the bandshell. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Walk Jordan Park’s trail
cards.subtitle: Jordan Park · Allentown
cards.notes: Find the trail across from the basketball courts and set a relaxed walking loop. Use the courts as a visible landmark, but keep the activity to the free public walk.
cards.short_summary: A trail meetup beside Jordan Park’s basketball courts.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Jordan Park’s trail across from the basketball courts as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: near the trail, across from basketball courts. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Walk from Roosevelt Park’s court
cards.subtitle: Roosevelt Park · Allentown
cards.notes: Meet near the basketball-court parking area on South Filmore Street, then take a short social walk in the park. Plan to finish before dusk under city park rules.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable court-side starting point for a free outdoor walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Roosevelt Park near the basketball court parking lot as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: South Filmore Street, near the basketball-court parking lot. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Walk the canal park trail
cards.subtitle: Lehigh Canal Park · Allentown
cards.notes: Use the trail near the boathouse as the meeting marker, entering at East Walnut and South Albert Streets. Walk with friends and skip the water; city rules prohibit swimming.
cards.short_summary: A canal-side walking destination marked by its boathouse.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Lehigh Canal Park’s trail near the boathouse as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: East Walnut Street and South Albert Street, trail near the boathouse. The City states, “Walking is free.”

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on nearby Allentown corridors, each paired with one source-backed reason to go.

cards.title: Allentown Fairgrounds Farmers Market
cards.subtitle: Chew Street corridor
cards.notes: Plan a Thursday–Saturday stop to browse the market’s food and specialty merchants; check its current hours before setting out.
cards.short_summary: An indoor market destination at 1825 W. Chew Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The market lists its address as 1825 W. Chew Street and regular Thursday, Friday, and Saturday hours.
cards.source_title: Allentown Fairgrounds Farmers Market — Contact Us
cards.access_notes: Regular hours listed: Thu 9 a.m.–7 p.m.; Fri 8 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sat 8 a.m.–6 p.m.

cards.title: Historic 19th Street Theatre
cards.subtitle: North 19th Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the cinema and theatre calendar, then head to the historic auditorium at 527 N. 19th Street for a scheduled screening or show.
cards.short_summary: Civic Theatre’s historic auditorium anchors this West End block.
cards.evidence_claim: Civic Theatre identifies the Historic 19th Street Theatre at 527 N. 19th Street in Allentown.
cards.source_title: Civic Theatre of Allentown — Directions & Locations
cards.access_notes: Review the theatre’s current performance or cinema schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Theatre514
cards.subtitle: North 19th Street corridor
cards.notes: Look for a Civic Theatre program scheduled in Theatre514, then use the venue’s listed 514 N. 19th Street location to find it.
cards.short_summary: A second Civic Theatre venue across the 19th Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Civic Theatre lists Theatre514 at 514 N. 19th Street, Allentown.
cards.source_title: Civic Theatre of Allentown — Directions & Locations
cards.access_notes: Programming varies; consult Civic Theatre’s current listings.

cards.title: The Udder Bar
cards.subtitle: West Allen Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the West Allen Street stop for ice cream, shakes, or sundaes, and confirm the daily closing time if you are going later.
cards.short_summary: A family-operated ice-cream parlor at 1852 W. Allen Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Udder Bar describes itself as a family-owned ice cream parlor and lists 1852 W. Allen Street, Allentown.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: noon–10 p.m. Monday–Thursday; noon–10:30 p.m. Friday–Sunday.

cards.title: Cedar Beach Park
cards.subtitle: Parkway Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Take the walking trail around Lake Muhlenberg, or use the park’s playground and courts; reserve facilities separately when an event requires it.
cards.short_summary: A 72.7-acre Cedar Creek Greenway park with active recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s 2025 parks plan says Cedar Beach Park has a walking trail around Lake Muhlenberg, basketball courts, volleyball courts, a playground, and pavilions.
cards.access_notes: Park amenities are outdoors; check city notices for event or facility restrictions.

cards.title: Malcolm Gross Rose Garden
cards.subtitle: Parkway Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Walk the garden paths and pause at the rose displays; follow posted garden rules and leave weddings or reserved uses plenty of space.
cards.short_summary: A named rose garden at 2800 Parkway Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Allentown Parks & Recreation lists Malcolm Gross Rose Garden at 2800 Parkway Boulevard as an open facility.
cards.source_title: City of Allentown Parks & Recreation — Facilities
cards.access_notes: The city lists the garden as open; reservations may apply to certain nearby facilities.

cards.title: Trexler Memorial Park
cards.subtitle: Springhouse Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the walking trails for a longer green-space loop, and look for the park’s historic features while staying on established paths.
cards.short_summary: A park with roughly three miles of trails and a historic spring house.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s parks plan describes approximately three miles of trails, a historic spring house, restrooms, and a pond at Trexler Memorial Park.
cards.access_notes: City facility information lists access from Broadway and Tilghman Street.

cards.title: Haines Mill Museum
cards.subtitle: Haines Mill Road corridor
cards.notes: Check the museum’s program calendar before going, then focus your visit on the water-powered milling equipment and preserved mill setting.
cards.short_summary: A restored working grist-mill museum in the county park system.
cards.evidence_claim: The Delaware & Lehigh National Heritage Corridor says Haines Mill was restored as a working grist-mill museum and describes its water-powered equipment.
cards.source_title: Delaware & Lehigh National Heritage Corridor — Haines Mill Museum
cards.access_notes: Confirm public program and operating details with the administering historical organization before visiting.

cards.title: Lehigh Parkway
cards.subtitle: Park Drive corridor
cards.notes: Choose a trail section from Park Drive, then build a walk or ride around the creek corridor; use the park map to select a suitable route.
cards.short_summary: A large Little Lehigh Creek park corridor with trails and bridle paths.
cards.evidence_claim: Friends of the Allentown Parks describes Lehigh Parkway as a 629-acre park along Little Lehigh Creek with scenic exercise trails and bridle paths.
cards.source_title: Friends of the Allentown Parks — Park Resources
cards.access_notes: Trail conditions and access points can vary; use a current park map and observe posted rules.

cards.title: Li’l-Le-Hi Trout Nursery
cards.subtitle: Fish Hatchery Road corridor
cards.notes: Pair a parkway walk with a stop at the hatchery edge, and look for current public information before making the trip to the nursery.
cards.short_summary: A trout nursery on the edge of Lehigh Parkway.
cards.evidence_claim: Friends of the Allentown Parks states that the Li’l-Le-Hi Trout Nursery sits on the edge of Lehigh Parkway and has operated along Little Lehigh Creek since 1883.
cards.source_title: Friends of the Allentown Parks — Park Resources
cards.access_notes: Check for public access and any operational notices before visiting.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Muhlenberg rituals and recurring campus events, from Welcome Weekend through Senior Days.

cards.title: Pass the Flame at Orientation
cards.subtitle: Welcome Weekend · Haas College Center lawn
cards.notes: Join the Welcome Weekend gathering outside Haas, where the president, alumni, and first-year students pass candlelight across the lawn.
cards.short_summary: A candlelit welcome that starts the Muhlenberg experience.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg says Orientation candle-lighting gathers students outside Haas College Center; the president lights the first candle and the flame is passed to first-year students.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of Orientation/Welcome Weekend; confirm the current program with the College.

cards.title: Receive a Red-and-Gray Scarf
cards.subtitle: Welcome Weekend · first-year and transfer welcome
cards.notes: Look for the post–candle-lighting scarf presentation, when alumni welcome new and transfer students into the Muhlenberg community.
cards.short_summary: A Welcome Weekend scarf ceremony for new Mules.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes scarving as a newer tradition following Welcome Weekend candle-lighting, with alumni presenting red and gray scarves to first-year and transfer students.
cards.access_notes: Occurs during Welcome Weekend; intended for new and transfer students.

cards.title: Reconnect at the Welcome Back Picnic
cards.subtitle: Burkholder Quad · before classes begin
cards.notes: Head to Burkholder Quad on the evening before classes for the annual gathering that reconnects returning students, faculty, and staff.
cards.short_summary: A pre-semester quad gathering that welcomes the campus back.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg identifies the Welcome Back Picnic as a gathering on Burkholder Quad held the evening before classes begin.
cards.access_notes: Held the evening before classes begin; check Welcome Weekend communications for timing.

cards.title: Hear Six Groups at A Cappella Fest
cards.subtitle: April · campus vocal performance tradition
cards.notes: Attend the April showcase to hear Muhlenberg’s a cappella groups together, with invited groups from other colleges and universities.
cards.short_summary: An annual vocal showcase that brings Muhlenberg’s ensembles together.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says A Cappella Fest is held each April and features Muhlenberg’s six a cappella groups plus special guests from other institutions.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in April; ticket proceeds support a local nonprofit, so verify current ticketing details.

cards.title: Watch Greek Sing Close Out Greek Week
cards.subtitle: Spring · Seegers Union Event Space
cards.notes: Catch the spring finale in Seegers, where Greek-letter chapters present dance and lip-synch performances after a week of activities.
cards.short_summary: A spring competition week ending in a performance night.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg says Greek Week includes activities and philanthropy, culminating in Greek Sing at the Seegers Union Event Space with dance/lip-synching performances.
cards.access_notes: Spring event; participation is connected to Greek-letter organizations, while performance attendance details should be confirmed locally.

cards.title: Cheer On Jefferson Field Day
cards.subtitle: May · campus fields and Life Sports Center
cards.notes: Look for the final-Friday-of-spring-semester event, when Jefferson Elementary students use Muhlenberg’s fields and Life Sports Center for games.
cards.short_summary: A yearly campus field day with Jefferson Elementary School.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says Jefferson Field Day occurs each May on the last Friday of the spring semester before finals and includes races, obstacle courses, and games.
cards.access_notes: A community-engagement event involving Jefferson Elementary students; participation roles are coordinated by the College.

cards.title: Take a Finals Break for Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Wood Dining Commons · finals week
cards.notes: During finals week, stop by Wood Dining Commons for the faculty, staff, and alumni-hosted breakfast served late in the evening.
cards.short_summary: A free finals-week breakfast served from 10 p.m. to midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg states that faculty, staff, and alumni host a free late-night breakfast for students at Wood Dining Commons from 10 p.m. to midnight during finals week.
cards.access_notes: Directly documented as 10 p.m.–midnight during finals week; confirm the current finals-week schedule.

cards.title: Return for the Senior Candle-lighting
cards.subtitle: Senior Days · before Commencement weekend
cards.notes: Graduating students gather during Senior Days to pass candlelight once again, revisiting the ritual that opened their time at Muhlenberg.
cards.short_summary: The candle tradition returns as a four-year bookend.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg says its Senior Days candle-lighting echoes Orientation, with graduating students passing light to adjacent peers before Commencement weekend.
cards.access_notes: Occurs during Senior Days preceding Commencement weekend and is for graduating students.

cards.title: Climb the Miller Bell Tower
cards.subtitle: Senior Days · Haas College Center
cards.notes: Eligible graduating students can take the guided Senior Days tour of the David A. Miller Bell Tower atop Haas College Center.
cards.short_summary: A guided tower visit offered through the senior class giving campaign.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says students who meet the Senior Class Connections Campaign gift challenge receive a guided Senior Days tour of the David A. Miller Bell Tower atop Haas College Center.
cards.access_notes: Participation requires meeting the current Senior Class Connections Campaign gift challenge; senior-only program.

cards.title: Mark National Mule Day
cards.subtitle: October 26 · Muhlenberg Activities Council programming
cards.notes: Check MAC’s October 26 program for the annual Mule-themed activities, which have included crafts, mocktails, photos, cookies, and giveaways.
cards.short_summary: An annual October 26 celebration centered on the Mule.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg identifies National Mule Day as an annual October 26 holiday programmed by the Muhlenberg Activities Council.
cards.access_notes: Annual date is October 26; activities vary by year, so consult MAC’s current announcement.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Muhlenberg College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A first-weekend campus sequence of ten distinct, under-21-safe stops for getting oriented, eating, studying, moving, and finding the arts.

cards.title: Start with a walk along Academic Row
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus orientation
cards.notes: Use the tree-lined Academic Row as a first pass through campus, then note the historic and modern buildings you may want to revisit with a map.
cards.short_summary: A simple opening walk to place the campus in context.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg identifies Academic Row as a tree-lined part of its campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus route; use the college map or a guided visit for orientation.

cards.title: Settle into Trexler Library
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · study and research hub
cards.notes: Walk through the three floors, find the service desk, and save the library hours page; bring your Muhlenberg ID for evening building access.
cards.short_summary: A practical early stop for study space and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: Trexler Library has three floors and offers personalized research assistance; a Muhlenberg ID is required to access the building after 8 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Hours can change; the college says doors lock 15 minutes before closing and ID is required after 8 p.m.

cards.title: Have your first dinner at Wood
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Seegers Union
cards.notes: Check the current menu before going, then choose from the dining platforms and ask dining staff about allergen, vegan, vegetarian, or kosher needs.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus dinner stop with several meal formats.
cards.evidence_claim: Wood Dining Commons offers chef-attended stations and customizable meals, with accommodations for dietary needs.
cards.access_notes: Meal purchase, meal plan, or other accepted dining payment is required for entry; confirm current hours and menu online.

cards.entity_name: Dorothy and Dexter Baker Center for the Arts
cards.title: Find the Baker Center’s creative spaces
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · arts and performance
cards.notes: Locate the Baker Center, then check the college arts calendar for a scheduled performance, exhibition, or public event that fits your weekend.
cards.short_summary: A gateway to Muhlenberg’s art, music, theatre, and dance spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baker Center for the Arts contains studios, shops, classrooms, and performance spaces and houses the art, English, music, theatre, and dance departments.
cards.access_notes: Building and event access may vary; consult the current arts calendar before planning a performance visit.

cards.title: Check what’s showing at Martin Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Baker Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Look up the current exhibition or public event, then plan a short gallery visit while you are already at the Baker Center.
cards.short_summary: An exhibition-focused pause within the arts complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Martin Art Gallery is located inside the Baker Center for the Arts and hosts exhibitions and other public events.
cards.access_notes: Confirm exhibition dates and public access before arriving.

cards.entity_name: Trexler Pavilion for Theatre and Dance
cards.title: Locate Trexler Pavilion for Theatre and Dance
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · theatre and dance
cards.notes: Use the posted season calendar to choose a production, then arrive with time to find the correct theatre or performance entrance.
cards.short_summary: A named campus home for theatre and dance facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg’s theatre facilities in Trexler Pavilion include the Paul C. Empie Theatre, Dorothy Hess Baker Theatre, Studio Theatre, dance studios, and rehearsal spaces.
cards.access_notes: Performance availability and ticket requirements vary by production; verify details through the current event listing.

cards.title: Get oriented at the Life Sports Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · athletics and recreation
cards.notes: Find the Life Sports Center and its connection to nearby facilities, then check the appropriate campus office for recreation access and current programming.
cards.short_summary: A campus athletics hub beside the stadium.
cards.evidence_claim: The Life Sports Center overlooks Scotty Wood Stadium and houses a cardio center, weight room, training room, and locker rooms, with access to Memorial Hall, Alumni Pool, and the John Deitrich Field House.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and recreational use are not stated on this page; confirm eligibility and hours before working out.

cards.title: Walk by Scotty Wood Stadium
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · outdoor athletics landmark
cards.notes: Add the stadium to your campus loop, then use the athletics schedule if you want to return for a listed home competition.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor landmark for locating Muhlenberg athletics.
cards.evidence_claim: Scotty Wood Stadium is the 3,000-seat home for Muhlenberg football, field hockey, men’s lacrosse, and track and field.
cards.access_notes: View athletics schedules and event-specific entry guidance before attending a competition.

cards.title: Keep Saturday dinner simple at General’s Quarters
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Seegers Union food court
cards.notes: Review the venue options, then choose a meal or grab-and-go item that suits your schedule before heading to an evening campus activity.
cards.short_summary: A food-court stop for a flexible Saturday meal.
cards.evidence_claim: General’s Quarters is a campus food court with grill, sandwich, sushi, grab-and-go, coffee, dessert, and beverage options.
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages require payment or eligible dining funds; current operating hours should be checked on the dining site.

cards.title: End by finding Haas College Center
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · campus-services landmark
cards.notes: Locate Haas College Center so you can return during the week for the college offices housed there, including practical student-facing services.
cards.short_summary: A useful final orientation stop before weekday errands begin.
cards.evidence_claim: Haas College Center is the former Haas Library and became the administrative heart of campus after Trexler Library opened.
cards.access_notes: Office access varies by department; check the relevant office page before making a special trip.
